KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.MSA.mastery: Gives the meaning of a word from the sentence it is in and picks the word that fits a gap in a sentence, without choosing a look-alike, a nearby or an opposite word, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.mastery: Answers who, what and which questions from a short story, puts four events in order, and gives the main message, without choosing a detail for the message or an answer from outside the story, in 8 of 10 new questions.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T1_INSHA_YA_WASIFU.AINA_Z.mastery: Names the kind of insha from a short text (wasifu describes a person or thing, masimulizi tells what happened in order, maelezo explains) and the part of an insha (utangulizi, kiini, hitimisho), in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_NOMINO.NOMINO.mastery: Picks the noun (the name of a person, animal, place or thing) from a group of words and a sentence, and fills a gap with a noun, without choosing a verb, an adjective or an adverb, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VITENZI.VITENZI.mastery: Picks the verb (the word for what someone or something does) from a group of words and a sentence, and fills a gap with a verb, without choosing a noun, an adjective or an adverb, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T1_VIVUMISHI.VIVUMISHI.mastery: Picks the adjective (the word that tells more about a noun) and uses the form that agrees with the noun (mtoto mdogo, watoto wadogo, kiti kikubwa), without choosing a noun or a verb, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T2_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.mastery: Picks the greeting or farewell that fits the person and the time (hujambo-sijambo, shikamoo-marahaba, habari za asubuhi, kwaheri, usiku mwema), without giving the greeting back as the reply, in 8 of 10 new situations. Using them aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.KAMUSI.mastery: Puts words in the order of the alphabet (using the second and third letters when the first match) and says what a dictionary is for, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIWAKILISHI.VIWAKILISH.mastery: Picks the pronoun (the word that stands in place of a noun: yeye, wao, sisi, huyu, hawa, yule, wale) that fits the person, number and nearness, without repeating the noun or choosing another word, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T2_VIELEZI.VIELEZI.mastery: Picks the adverb (the word that tells how, when or where something is done: polepole, jana, shuleni) and says which of the three it tells, without choosing an adjective or a noun, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T3_VITENDAWILI.VITENDAWIL.mastery: Tells a kitendawili from a methali, a nahau and an ordinary sentence, gives the opening words of riddling (Kitendawili! Tega!), and the answer to a known riddle, in 8 of 10 new items. Telling and guessing aloud is a teacher's check.

forms: choose what a good reader does
KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.UFA.mastery: Names what a fluent reader does (good pronunciation, a fitting voice, a fitting speed, a rest at the marks, signs that fit), without taking fast or loud for good, in 8 of 10 new items. Reading aloud itself is for a teacher to hear.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.S.mastery: Names the part of a computer for typing and showing (kibodi, kipanya, skrini, kichapishi, the space key) and what each one does, in 8 of 10 new items. Using the computer is a practical task.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T3_KUANDIKA_KWA_TARAKIL.U.mastery: Chooses the sentence with the right capital letter, kikomo (full stop), kiulizi (question mark), koma and alama ya hisi (!), and finds the one mistake in a short note, in 8 of 10 new sentences.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIUNGANISHI.VIUNGANISH.mastery: Picks the joining word (na, pia, kwa sababu, lakini, ili, au) that fits the meaning of two parts of a sentence, without choosing a noun or a verb or a joining word of another meaning, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHUSISHI.VIHUSISHI.mastery: Picks the relating word (juu ya, chini ya, ndani ya, nje ya, karibu na, mbali na, kwa, kuliko) in a sentence, and chooses the -a of agreement (cha, vya, wa, ya, la) that matches the noun, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T3_VIHISISHI.VIHISISHI.mastery: Picks the exclamation that fits the feeling in the situation (pole, hongera, samahani, karibu, lo) and picks the exclamation from a sentence, with the exclamation mark, without choosing a noun or a verb, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T4_MANENO_YA_UPOLE.UPOLE.mastery: Picks the polite word or sentence (tafadhali, samahani, asante, pole, naomba) for the situation, and does not choose a command, in 8 of 10 new items. Using them aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_MAPANA.USAL.mastery: Picks the safe step for a phone, tablet or computer (keep the password secret, show an adult an unknown link, give no home address to a stranger, log out, use a safe site) and not the risky one, in 8 of 10 new situations.

KISW.G4.KUANDI.T4_BARUA_YA_KIRAFIKI.BARU.mastery: Names the parts of a friendly letter in their order (anwani ya mwandishi, tarehe, salamu, mwili, hitimisho, jina) and what each holds, in 8 of 10 new items. Writing the letter is composition marking.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T4_NGELI_YA_A_WA.A_WA.mastery: Knows that people and animals are in A-WA, gives a- for one and wa- for many (mtoto anacheza, watoto wanacheza), and makes the plural noun (mwalimu-walimu), in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T5_METHALI.METHALI.mastery: Tells a methali about upbringing from other sayings, gives what it means, and completes it, without taking it word for word or giving the meaning of another methali, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.SHA.mastery: Says what a shairi, an ubeti and a mshororo are, counts the beti and the mishororo in a short poem, and tells a poem from a paragraph by its shape, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T5_NGELI_YA_U_I.U_I.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to U-I (mti, mlango, mkono, mkoba, mguu), gives u- for one and i- for many, and makes the plural noun (mti-miti), without using the prefix of people, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T6_SHAIRI.SHAIRI_MSAMIATI.mastery: Gives the meaning of the words of a poem about the nation (bendera, taifa, uhuru, shujaa, mshikamano, amani) and uses them in a sentence, without choosing a look-alike or an opposite word, in 8 of 10 new items. Reciting is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_KINA.MAKALA.mastery: Answers questions about a short article (makala) from what it says, and gives its main message, without choosing a detail for the message or an answer from outside the article, in 8 of 10 new questions.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T6_NGELI_YA_LI_YA.LI_YA.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to LI-YA (jiwe, jicho, tunda, embe, dirisha, jina), gives li- for one and ya- for many, and makes the plural noun with ma- (jiwe-mawe, tunda-matunda), in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T7_NAHAU.NAHAU.mastery: Tells a nahau from other sayings and gives what it means (kupiga moyo konde, kujikaza kisabuni, kula kiapo, kukata tamaa), without taking it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_KI_VI.KI_VI.mastery: Knows nouns that belong to KI-VI (kitabu, kiti, kikombe, kisu, kiatu), gives ki- for one and vi- for many, and makes the plural noun (kitabu-vitabu, kiatu-viatu), in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T7_NGELI_YA_LI_LI.LI_LI.mastery: Knows the nouns the design gives for LI-LI (jua, giza), whose noun has the same form for one and for many, and uses li- with them (jua limetoka, giza limeingia), without using the prefix of another class, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T8_VISAWE.VISAWE.mastery: Picks the word with the same meaning (haraka-upesi, shida-taabu, furaha-raha) and does not choose a look-alike, an opposite or a related word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using visawe aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.IGI.mastery: Tells a short play (igizo) from a story by its shape (the name of the speaker, a colon, the words said), names the speaker of a line, and finds the stage direction in brackets, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T8_MNYAMBULIKO_WA_VITEN.M.mastery: Tells the three verb forms apart (kutenda: andika, kutendea: andikia, done for someone, kutendwa: andikwa, done to the thing) and picks the one a sentence needs, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_KIMUKT.M.mastery: Tells an informal setting (with a friend, at play, at home) from a formal one (a speech, an interview, a meeting) and picks the words that fit it, in 8 of 10 new items. Using them aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T9_VINYUME_VYA_NOMINO.VIN.mastery: Gives the true opposite of a noun (usiku-mchana, rafiki-adui, furaha-huzuni, tajiri-maskini) and does not choose a related word or a word of the same meaning, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.KUSIKI.T10_TASHBIHI.TASHBIHI.mastery: Gives the usual comparison for height, size and shape (mrefu kama twiga, mnene kama kiboko, mkubwa kama ndovu) and says it is a simile because of kama, without taking it word for word, in 8 of 10 new items. Using it aloud is a teacher's check.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T10_NYAKATI_NA_HALI.NYAKA.mastery: Uses -li- for what happened before (jana alisoma), -na- for now (anasoma) and -ta- for what will happen (atasoma), following the time word, and gives the right person prefix, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKANUSHAJI.UKANUSHAJI.mastery: Makes the negative of a verb in the past (hakusoma), present (hasomi) and future (hatasoma) for the person, and tells a negative from a positive verb, without only adding ha- or keeping the tense marker, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UKUBWA_WA_NOMINO.UKUB.mastery: Gives the big form (ji-) of the m- nouns with a one-syllable root (mti-jiti, mto-jito, mji-jiji, mtu-jitu) for one and for many (majiti), and does not keep the noun, use ki-, or give one for many, in 8 of 10 new items.

KISW.G4.SARUFI.T11_UDOGO_WA_NOMINO.UDOGO.mastery: Gives the small form (ki-) of the m- nouns with a one-syllable root (mti-kijiti, mto-kijito, mji-kijiji, mtu-kijitu) for one and for many (vijiti), and does not keep the noun, use ji-, or give one for many, in 8 of 10 new items.
